record_type_quote:
This preregistered direct-replication attempt followed the
replication recipe of Brandt et al. (2014), and was conducted
across multiple labs, with independent data sets collected
at four US Universities, with each receiving approval from
their respective Institutional Review Board.

targets.title: Enclothed cognition.
targets.evidence_quote:
Given that the Stroop paradigm is well recognized as the
standard for selective attention research, this replication at-
tempt will focus on the results from experiment 1 and not
experiments 2 and 3.
targets.outcome_quote:
Theoretically predicted sequential eﬀects as small as 7 ms
were successfully detected at α = .05, indicating that the failure to ﬁnd an eﬀect of lab coat is
likely not due to power limitations or poor experimental technique.
targets.outcome_reasoning: New-data replication failed to detect the central lab-coat effect; equivalence testing rules out the effect magnitude of interest. Sequential effects are positive controls, not additional replication targets. Original-data analyses supplement the main new-data replication.
